scope: Evaluation-only Prompt intervention, with two finite development LIVE batches under standing DeepSeek test authorization

offline_verification.command: pnpm --filter @flowlens/server exec vitest run test/pipeline-eval-prompt.test.ts test/pipeline-controlled.test.ts --silent --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=../../logs/pipeline/effect/grounded-actions-offline-tests.json
offline_verification.meaning: Verifies message transformation, logging/version integrity and real isolated protocol execution; scripted responses do not measure reasoning

assistant_readonly_assessment.type: AI trace inspection, not human signoff
assistant_readonly_assessment.D07: Final answer recognizes valid source SQL/output and target conflict, leaves provenance and handling policy unknown, requests manual investigation and does not invent a candidate
assistant_readonly_assessment.repair_regression: All six SQL candidates pass fixed, holdout, robustness and native platform validation; the variant did not turn every problem into MANUAL_REQUIRED in this trial
remaining_semantic_risks: D02 uses equal row count as part of an overly strong statement that no row-level deviation occurred; counts alone are insufficient
D01/D05/D06 state platform ownership of target fields more strongly than the current tools explicitly establish, even though production code does inject those fields
Some explanations list unrelated platform fields, adding noise
Five of seven final responses required one JSON-only correction; first-response output-format reliability remains weak
assistant_readonly_assessment.limits: A single trial on each development case cannot establish stable semantic correctness or a causal Prompt improvement; no held-out Agent evaluation was performed

baseline_comparison.interpretation: Promising targeted action improvement with unchanged valid-repair behavior in this small trial; production baseline remains unchanged

next_scope: Freeze this evaluated variant and review wording/format reliability before considering production adoption; do not alter labels or claim 100 percent diagnosis accuracy
